title: Uday Kotak expects RBI to further increase repo rate by 75 basis points - Mid-Day

Uday Kotak expects RBI to further increase repo rate by 75 basis points 
 Home / Business / Business News / Article / RBI likely to further increase repo rate by 75 basis points: Uday Kotak 
 RBI likely to further increase repo rate by 75 basis points: Uday Kotak
 Updated On: 06 November, 2026 12:14 PM IST | Mumbai | mid-day online correspondent 
 Last month, the apex bank had increased its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5 per cent, its first rate hike since February 2023. RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra had said rate cuts were off the table in the near term
 Listen to this article : Uday Kotak. File picture.
 Kotak Mahindra Bank founder and non-executive director Uday Kotak on Thursday said the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is likely to increase its benchmark lending rate or repo rate by another 0.75 per cent as part of the current rate hike cycle, according to news agency PTI.
 "We have seen the first move by RBI. I see another 50 to 75 basis points movement up on interest rates," he said in a special video message posted by the group's broking arm.
